text:
alana: Quick Q — we keep seeing support tickets where customers think SDK 'Rate limit exceeded' is a bug. Current SDK throws a generic 429 error with "error: Rate limit exceeded". Can we agree on better client-facing copy + headers that make retry behavior clear? :thinking_face:

matt: Agree. Two pieces: (1) API surface (headers + HTTP code) to signal retryability and reset window, (2) SDK mapping to a typed error with .retryAfter and .reason so apps can show actionable UI.

nora: +1. Also need to differentiate per-key short bursts vs per-org sustained caps. Customers hit bursts during onboarding tests and think they "used up" their org quota. We should show "burst available" in console and return header info reflecting which limit triggered.

harry: Proposal: keep 429 as the HTTP status, but add structured headers: `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Type: per-key|per-org|route` and `Retry-After: <seconds>`. Also `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset: <unix_ts>` for precise countdown. SDK can parse those.

jordan: I like explicit type header. Can we also include `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reason`, e.g. `burst_limit_exhausted` vs `sustained_quota`? Makes UI copy simpler.

nora: +1 to reason. For burst behavior we use leaky-bucket; when burst drained, Retry-After is short (seconds). For sustained caps it's longer (mins->hrs). UI should surface "Try again in Xs" and "Contact sales to raise quota" depending on type.

alana: On SDK error object shape, propose: `class RateLimitError extends RedwoodError { boolean retryable; number retryAfter; string scope; string reason; }` SDKs would expose `error.retryable` and `error.retryAfterMs`. Thoughts on naming?

matt: `retryAfterMs` is handy. Also include `limitWindowSeconds` maybe. But keep surface small. Example JS mapping: 
```js
// SDK throws
throw new RateLimitError({
  retryable: true,
  retryAfterMs: 15000,
  scope: 'org',
  reason: 'sustained_quota'
});
```

harry: Docs should spell out recommended client backoff strategy. My vote: immediate short jittered retry for burst (<=5s), exponential backoff for sustained (start 500ms * 2^n capped at 60s) + respect Retry-After header when provided.

devex-bot: heads-up: UX PR exists that shows quota usage per-route; linking: https://git.redwood/ux/quota-panel-2026 (WIP)

alana: Console copy suggestions (two variants):
- Short inline banner when request blocked by burst: "Temporarily hitting short burst limits. Try again in ~{N}s. If you consistently need higher throughput, request increased burst capacity."
- For org quota: "Request blocked by organization quota. Next reset: {time}. Contact your admin or upgrade plan to increase throughput."

jordan: Also add a small CTA button: "Wait & retry" that runs a client-side retry respecting `retryAfter`. For SPAs we can use `navigator.sendBeacon` or queued retry.

nora: We should decide on a machine-readable error code in body too, e.g.: { "code": "rate_limit_exceeded", "retry_after": 15, "type": "org", "reason": "sustained_quota" } — SDKs can prefer headers but fall back to body.

matt: Good fallback. Make sure body `retry_after` is seconds (int). Avoid ambiguity about units.

harry: On telemetry: include `rate_limit.type`, `rate_limit.reason`, and `rate_limit.triggered_by_route` in our logs and traces so Optimize can correlate patterns. Telemetry events should also include `is_burst` boolean.

alana: Backwards compat: older clients expect only 429. We should keep 429 + Retry-After header for now. New headers and body fields can be opt-in via `X-Redwood-Feature: rate-limit-v2` header while we test.

jordan: Can we have SDKs send that feature header by default to get the better shape? Risk: some proxies may strip unknown headers. Maybe enable in hosted and dedicated first.

ops-bot: infra note — adding `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset` requires minimal changes to the rate limiter, I can add unix reset ts. But `type`/`reason` will need the limiter to emit category; will add a config flag for routes.

alana: Action items: (1) API: add headers `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Type`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reason`, `X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset`, keep `Retry-After`. (2) SDKs: surface RateLimitError with `retryable` + `retryAfterMs` + `scope` + `reason`. (3) Console: two copy variants + "Wait & retry" button + show burst vs quota. (4) Docs: backoff recipes + examples in JS/python. (5) Telemetry: add fields noted by harry.

matt: I'll open a concise PR with the proposed header names + example bodies. Will ping eng-runtime for header plumbing.

nora: I'll draft console copy and mockup for the CTA.

alana: Great — thanks. If folks agree I'll mark RFC as approved and we can start rollouts behind `rate-limit-v2` flag. :thumbsup:

harry: Approve from me.

jordan: Approve.

alana: Cool. I'll post follow-up with the tracking ticket and target rollout dates.

devex-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood/sdk/pull/437 — implements RateLimitError in JS SDK (draft).

alana: Nice. Let's iterate copy in the PR comments.

matt: Noted — will include sample server response and a table mapping `type+reason -> recommended UI` in the PR description.

alana: Thanks all!
